Matrix.{u, u', v} (m : Type u) (n : Type u') (α : Type v) : Type (max u u' v)
```
***
`Matrix m n R` is the type of matrices with entries in `R`, whose rows are indexed by `m`
and whose columns are indexed by `n`. 
***
*import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Basic*

```lean
Matrix.trace.{u_3, u_6} {n : Type u_3} {R : Type u_6} [Fintype n] [AddCommMonoid R] (A : Matrix n n R) : R
```
***
The trace of a square matrix. For more bundled versions, see:
* `Matrix.traceAddMonoidHom`
* `Matrix.traceLinearMap`

***
*import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Trace*

```lean
Matrix.charpoly.{u_1, u_4} {R : Type u_1} [CommRing R] {n : Type u_4} [DecidableEq n] [Fintype n] (M : Matrix n n R) :
  R[X]
```
***
The characteristic polynomial of a matrix `M` is given by $\det (t I - M)$.

***
*import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Charpoly.Basic*

```lean
Polynomial.roots.{u} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] (p : R[X]) : Multiset R
```
***
`roots p` noncomputably gives a multiset containing all the roots of `p`,
including their multiplicities. 
***
*import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots*

```lean
Multiset.sum.{u_3} {α : Type u_3} [AddCommMonoid α] : Multiset α → α
```
***
Sum of a multiset given a commutative additive monoid structure on `α`.
`sum {a, b, c} = a + b + c`
***
*import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Multiset*

```lean
Matrix.trace_eq_sum_roots_charpoly_of_splits.{u_1, u_2} {n : Type u_1} [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] {R : Type u_2}
  [Field R] {A : Matrix n n R} (hAps : Splits (RingHom.id R) A.charpoly) : A.trace = A.charpoly.roots.sum
```

```lean
IsAlgClosed.splits.{u} {k : Type u} [Field k] [self : IsAlgClosed k] (p : k[X]) : Splits (RingHom.id k) p
